description: Sold-price comps for a described item, computed across the full government-surplus market in any market listed in `country`. Signed out: coverage only (how many comparable sales, confidence, and a coarse price band). Signed in or with an API key: the actual 25th/median/75th percentile final prices. `liveListingsUrl` links to the live auctions for the same item. A miss says which kind it is: reason `insufficient_comps` (too few comparable sales yet) is worth retrying, reason `category_not_priceable` (real-estate) never is — that category cannot be priced from a title. A catch-all `category` such as `miscellaneous` is not refused: it is dropped and the item is priced on its title alone, with `requestedCategory` and `categoryDropped` echoed back — check the resolved `category` and `confidence` before trusting the range.

include.description: Set to "comps" to also return the individual sales the range was computed from (title, final price, sale month, state). Requires a key; the number returned is capped by plan. Not served for EU markets (DE, FR, NL, PL): the range is returned with `compsWithheld: true`.

limit.description: How many underlying sales to return with include=comps. Capped by plan.

state.description: Optional 2-letter state/region code for a regional range. Falls back to the national range when that state has too few sales; the response's `scope` field says which you got.

name: get_sold_comps
title: Sold-price comps
